max_jobs.description: Maximum number of simultaneous print jobs allowed system-wide.

lpd_user.description: User account under which the LPD daemon runs.

spool_dir.description: Base directory for spooling print jobs (unless overridden per queue).

bind_address.description: IP address to bind the LPD server to (empty string = bind to all interfaces).

port.description: TCP port on which to listen for LPD connections.

remote_enable.description: Allow print jobs from remote hosts via LPD protocol.

log_access.description: Enable access logging (successful/failed jobs, client IPs).

printcap.description: Path to the printcap database file defining queues and devices.

log_file.description: File to write LPD logs (ignored if logging is disabled).

name.description: Unique identifier for the queue (used in [queue] section headers).

spool_dir.description: Per-queue spool directory (empty = use global spool_dir).

device.description: Device or backend command for the printer (e.g., /dev/lp0, or 'lp -d HP_LaserJet').

filter.description: Filter program to preprocess print jobs (optional, e.g., a PostScript filter).

enabled.description: Whether this queue is active and accepts jobs.

max_job_size.description: Maximum job size in bytes (0 = no limit).

allowed_users.description: List of allowed usernames or groups (prefixed with '@'); empty = all users allowed.

items.description: A username or group name (group names must be prefixed with '@').

denied_users.description: List of denied usernames or groups; empty = none denied.

items.description: A username or group name (group names must be prefixed with '@').

hold_job.description: Whether new jobs are held by default (requires manual release).
